description: This Java class 'TSetIpAddressProcessor' extends a Thrift processor to set IP address and username context for HiveServer2 operations, primarily handling socket transports and SASL authentication.

classes.name: TSetIpAddressProcessor
classes.description: A Thrift processor extension that sets IP address and username context for HiveServer2 operations based on transport type.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Overrides the process method to set IP address and username before processing the request.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Extracts and stores the username from SASL server transport if available.

methods.name: setIpAddress
methods.description: Determines and stores the IP address from the underlying socket transport.

methods.name: getUnderlyingSocketFromTransport
methods.description: Traverses nested transports to find and return the underlying TSocket.

methods.name: getUserIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the stored IP address for the current thread.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the stored username for the current thread.
